items.question: Who must place the mantra's syllables upon the prepared image?
premises: A prepared image has been established in the preceding ritual steps.
The syllables of a mantra are the elements to be placed.
A skilled practitioner is the designated agent of this placement.
items.inference: The skilled practitioner should then place the mantra's syllables upon that prepared image.
uncertainties: The specific mantra whose syllables are to be placed is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then the skilled practitioner should place the syllables of the mantra there upon the prepared image.
